title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 609 Portsmouth Avenue in Greenland, New Hampshire, as the "Chief Michael Maloney Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 609 Portsmouth Avenue in Greenland, New Hampshire, as the Chief Michael Maloney Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a post office building in Greenland, New Hampshire after Chief Michael Maloney.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 609 Portsmouth Avenue in Greenland, New Hampshire, as the Chief Michael Maloney Post Office Building. It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
